serverInfo.name: velora-global-mcp
serverInfo.title: Velora Global Platform MCP Server
serverInfo.description: Exposes Velora Global platform tools to AI assistants for certificate verification, domain internship search, guided training track discovery, and founder mentorship access.

tools.name: verifyCertificate
tools.description: Verifies a student internship or training certificate by ID, returning student name, domain, grade, and cryptographic issue date.

tools.name: getInternshipTracks
tools.description: Retrieves the list of 10 specialized industry internship domain tracks, durations (2 weeks to 6 months), and pricing in NPR.

tools.name: getTrainingPrograms
tools.description: Retrieves structured guided training programs with interactive modules, mentorship schedules, and syllabus breakdowns.
